_comment: Confirmed against a July 2026 Microsoft 365 admin center Agents > All agents > Registry XLSX export. Header matching is case-insensitive. Review this alias map when Microsoft changes the export contract.
_owner_semantics: Owner is a UPN/email in the validated export and maps to owner_upn. Creator Id is a distinct GUID and is intentionally not mapped to owner_id or treated as the owner.
